d: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed a public gathering in Pune during the launch of an extended Pune Metro line connecting Hinjawadi to Shivajinagar. He emphasised how modern urban transport drives productivity, economic expansion, and ease of living for the middle class. Reviewing national progress, Modi pointed out that India's operational metro network expanded from 248 kilometres across five cities in 2014 to around 1,200 kilometres across 26 cities today, positioning it among the top three metro systems globally.
